title: Numbers 18 — The charge of the priests and the Levites + their portions, oblations, firstfruits, and tithes

citations: Milgrom, Studies in Levitical Terminology I (1970)
verdicts.reasoning: wəzār lōʾ-yiqraḇ: in Priestly sanctuary law zār is anyone outside the authorized circle (v 22 includes ordinary Israelites). 'An outsider' (NRSV, NJPS) is accurate where the ASV's 'stranger' now misleads.
Exact.
lāḵem mattānâ nəṯunîm laYHWH: exact.
ʿăḇōḏaṯ mattānâ 'a service of gift' (ASV), lammibbêṯ lappārōḵeṯ 'within the veil', and 'the outsider who comes near' are consistent with v 4. The quotation closes correctly.

mišmereṯ tərûmōṯāy 'the charge of my oblations': tərûmâ under the corpus ruling. ləmošḥâ 'by reason of the anointing' (ASV) is defensible, and the alternative 'as a portion' (BDB mošḥâ II; NJPS) is recorded.

Re-parsed kol-qorbānām ləḵol-minḥāṯām ûləḵol-ḥaṭṭāʾṯām ûləḵol-ʾăšāmām. The lamed series specifies what qorbānām covers, so the Hebrew gives a heading followed by three species, not four coordinate items. The ASV marks this with 'even' and NJPS with 'namely'. The line reads 'every offering of theirs, every meal-offering of theirs, and every sin-offering ...', which makes qorbān look like a fourth item. Proposed: 'every offering of theirs, namely every meal-offering of theirs, and every sin-offering of theirs, and every guilt-offering of theirs which they render to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.' [Resolved at human sign-off, 2026-11-01: the requested fix was applied by the editor.]
bəqōḏeš haqqŏḏāšîm tōʾḵălennû: the ASV's 'as the most holy things' is kept, with the locative 'in a most holy place' (Milgrom; NJPS) recorded. Defensible.
tərûmaṯ mattānām ... ləḵol-tənûp̄ōṯ: 'oblation' and 'wave-offerings' (ASV) under the ruling. Exact.
ḥēleḇ 'the best' (figurative), tîrôš 'new wine' (BDB; ASV 'vintage'), rēʾšîṯām 'the first-fruits of them'. Accurate.

bikkûrê kol-ʾăšer bəʾarṣām ... ləḵā yihyeh: 'first-ripe fruits' is kept distinct from rēʾšîṯ (v 12). The reception note is accurate: TBWTT ch. 3 quotes the verse against the manna, and the note observes that the Hebrew assigns the produce to Aharon's house. The line encodes nothing.
kol-ḥērem 'every devoted thing' (ASV) is the consecrated-property sense, and it is compatible with joshua-woh's 'the devoted thing'.
kol-peṭer reḥem ... ʾăšer-yaqrîḇû 'which they bring near' (ASV 'offer'), keeping hiqrîḇ's root. Accurate.
ûp̄əḏûyāw ... bəʿerkəḵā ... ʿeśrîm gērâ hûʾ: ASV construction kept; exact.

tizrōq 'dash' (ASV 'sprinkle') is the central term. ʾiššeh 'an offering made by fire' is the ASV rendering, with Milgrom's 'food gift' recorded, and ləriaḥ nîḥōaḥ follows the central entry. Defensible.
kaḥăzēh hattənûp̄â ûḵəšôq hayyāmîn: exact.
kōl tərûmōṯ haqqŏḏāšîm ʾăšer yārîmû: noun and verb of rwm are rendered 'oblations ... set apart' (NJPS 'set aside'), which is accurate and replaces the ritual-gesture 'heave'. bərîṯ melaḥ is literal.
Exact; quotation reopens correctly.
kol-maʿăśēr ... ḥēlep̄ ʿăḇōḏāṯām: exact.
lāśēʾṯ ḥēṭʾ lāmûṯ 'lest they bear sin and die' (ASV); exact in sense.
Exact.
ʾăšer yārîmû laYHWH tərûmâ 'which they set apart for YHWH as an oblation'; consistent with the ruling.
Formula; exact.
wahărēmōṯem mimmennû tərûmaṯ YHWH maʿăśēr min-hammaʿăśēr: exact under the ruling. The nested speech is marked correctly.
wəneḥšaḇ ... kaddāḡān min-haggōren wəḵamməlēʾâ min-hayyāqeḇ: exact.
kēn tārîmû ... tərûmaṯ YHWH: exact under the ruling.
mikkol-ḥelbô ʾeṯ-miqdəšô mimmennû: literal (ASV structure) under the ruling.
bahărîməḵem ʾeṯ-ḥelbô 'when you have set apart the best of it': exact under the ruling.
śāḵār 'reward' (ASV) is kept, with 'payment/wage' in the commentary. Defensible.
Exact; the nested quotation closes correctly.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֔ן אַתָּ֗ה וּבָנֶ֤יךָ וּבֵית־אָבִ֙יךָ֙ אִתָּ֔ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־עֲוֺ֣ן הַמִּקְדָּ֑שׁ וְאַתָּה֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֔ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־עֲוֺ֥ן כְּהֻנַּתְכֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And YHWH said to Aharon, "You and your sons and your father's house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

notes.official: *ʾattâ ûḇāneyḵā ûḇêṯ-ʾāḇîḵā ʾittāḵ tiśʾû ʾeṯ-ʿăwōn hammiqdāš* 'You and your sons and your father's house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary'. *nāśāʾ ʿāwōn* is to bear the responsibility, and the penalty, for offences against the sanctuary: the priests and Levites answer for any encroachment (Milgrom, *Studies in Levitical Terminology*, 1970; Milgrom, *Numbers*, JPS, 1990). The chapter answers the people's fear after the rebellion of Qorach and the plague (17:27-28 MT). Names follow `hebrew-proper-name-transliteration-convention-torah` (Aharon = ASV Aaron; 'Moses', v 25, is the grandfathered exodus-woh form).

paragraphs.text: וְגַ֣ם אֶת־אַחֶיךָ֩ מַטֵּ֨ה לֵוִ֜י שֵׁ֤בֶט אָבִ֙יךָ֙ הַקְרֵ֣ב אִתָּ֔ךְ וְיִלָּו֥וּ עָלֶ֖יךָ וִֽישָׁרְת֑וּךָ וְאַתָּה֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֔ךְ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל הָעֵדֻֽת׃

i18n.en: And your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, bring near with you, that they may be joined to you and minister to you, while you and your sons with you are before the tent of the Testimony.

notes.official: *wəḡam ʾeṯ-ʾaḥeyḵā maṭṭēh lēwî šēḇeṭ ʾāḇîḵā* 'And your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father': two words for 'tribe', *maṭṭeh* (literally 'staff') and *šēḇeṭ* ('rod'), both 'tribe' as in the ASV. *wəyillāwû ʿāleyḵā* 'that they may be joined to you' puns on the name *lēwî*, as Leah's naming does at Gen 29:34 (*yillāweh ʾîšî* 'my husband will be joined to me'). *ʾōhel hāʿēḏuṯ* 'the tent of the Testimony' (`edut-the-testimony-capitalisation-torah`).

paragraphs.text: וְשָֽׁמְרוּ֙ מִֽשְׁמַרְתְּךָ֔ וּמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת כָּל־הָאֹ֑הֶל אַךְ֩ אֶל־כְּלֵ֨י הַקֹּ֤דֶשׁ וְאֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֔בוּ וְלֹֽא־יָמֻ֥תוּ גַם־הֵ֖ם גַּם־אַתֶּֽם׃

i18n.en: And they shall keep your charge and the charge of all the tent; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they nor you.

notes.official: *mišmarṯəḵā* 'your charge': *mišmereṯ* is guard duty (Milgrom 1970). The Levites guard the tent but may not approach the holy vessels or the altar, on pain of death for them and for the priests.

paragraphs.text: וְנִלְו֣וּ עָלֶ֔יךָ וְשָֽׁמְר֗וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֙רֶת֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד לְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאֹ֑הֶל וְזָ֖ר לֹא־יִקְרַ֥ב אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And they shall be joined to you and keep the charge of the tent of meeting, for all the service of the tent; and an outsider shall not come near to you.

notes.official: *wəzār lōʾ-yiqraḇ ʾălêḵem* 'and an outsider shall not come near to you' (draft and ASV 'a stranger'). In the sanctuary law *zār* is anyone outside the authorized group, here every non-priest and non-Levite, ordinary Israelites included (v 22), not a foreigner; the line uses 'outsider' with NRSV and NJPS (new overlay `zar-outsider-cultic-numbers-18`). *wənilwû* 'they shall be joined', the pun of v 2 again.

paragraphs.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֵ֖ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה ע֛וֹד קֶ֖צֶף עַל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

i18n.en: And you shall keep the charge of the sanctuary and the charge of the altar, that there be no more wrath upon the children of Yisra'el.

notes.official: *qeṣep̄* 'wrath', the divine anger that breaks out at encroachment (1:53; 17:11 MT).

paragraphs.text: וַאֲנִ֗י הִנֵּ֤ה לָקַ֙חְתִּי֙ אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָכֶ֞ם מַתָּנָ֤ה נְתֻנִים֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לַעֲבֹ֕ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

i18n.en: And I, behold, I have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Yisra'el; to you they are a gift, given to YHWH, to do the service of the tent of meeting.

notes.official: *lāḵem mattānâ nəṯunîm laYHWH* 'to you they are a gift, given to YHWH': the Levites are given to YHWH in place of the firstborn (3:12; 8:16-19) and by YHWH to the priests.

paragraphs.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִ֠תְּךָ תִּשְׁמְר֨וּ אֶת־כְּהֻנַּתְכֶ֜ם לְכָל־דְּבַ֧ר הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ וּלְמִבֵּ֥ית לַפָּרֹ֖כֶת וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֑ם עֲבֹדַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗ה אֶתֵּן֙ אֶת־כְּהֻנַּתְכֶ֔ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃ (ס)

i18n.en: And you and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar and for what is within the veil, and you shall serve. I give you your priesthood as a service of gift; and the outsider who comes near shall be put to death."

notes.official: *ûləmibbêṯ lappārōḵeṯ* 'and for what is within the veil': *pārōḵeṯ* is the curtain before the most holy place (Ex 26:31-33); the ASV 'veil' is kept. *ʿăḇōḏaṯ mattānâ ʾettēn ʾeṯ-kəhunnatḵem* 'I give you your priesthood as a service of gift' (ASV; NJPS 'a service of dedication'): the priesthood is itself a gift (`priestly-dues-vocabulary-numbers-18`). *wəhazzār haqqārēḇ yûmāṯ* 'and the outsider who comes near shall be put to death' (draft 'stranger'; `zar-outsider-cultic-numbers-18`; the same formula at 1:51; 3:10, 38).

paragraphs.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹן֒ וַאֲנִי֙ הִנֵּ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְךָ֔ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת תְּרוּמֹתָ֑י לְכָל־קָדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל לְךָ֨ נְתַתִּ֧ים לְמָשְׁחָ֛ה וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ לְחָק־עוֹלָֽם׃

i18n.en: And YHWH spoke to Aharon, "And I, behold, I have given you the charge of my oblations, of all the holy things of the children of Yisra'el; to you I have given them by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.

notes.official: *mišmereṯ tərûmōṯāy* 'the charge of my oblations' (draft and ASV 'my heave-offerings'). *tərûmâ* is the portion set apart from a larger whole for YHWH and assigned by him to the priests. The central `qorbanot-sacrificial-offering-vocabulary-cluster-cross-corpus` rendered it 'oblation' in Ezekiel and reserved the Torah for review; this wave carries out the review and extends 'oblation' to the Torah, with the verb *hērîm* 'set apart' (vv 19, 24, 26, 28-30, 32). The ASV 'heave-offering' rests on an explanation by a lifting gesture that the texts do not support (Milgrom 1990, excursus on the *tərûmâ*; NJPS 'gifts'). *ləmošḥâ* 'by reason of the anointing' (ASV; Rashi) or, from a homonym *mšḥ* II, 'as a portion, perquisite' (BDB *mošḥâ* II; NJPS; NRSV); the ASV is kept and the alternative recorded (`priestly-dues-vocabulary-numbers-18`). *ləḥoq-ʿôlām* 'as a portion forever' (ASV; NJPS 'a due for all time').

paragraphs.text: זֶֽה־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ מִקֹּ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים מִן־הָאֵ֑שׁ כָּל־קָ֠רְבָּנָם לְֽכָל־מִנְחָתָ֞ם וּלְכָל־חַטָּאתָ֗ם וּלְכָל־אֲשָׁמָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָשִׁ֣יבוּ לִ֔י קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים לְךָ֛ ה֖וּא וּלְבָנֶֽיךָ׃

i18n.en: This shall be yours of the most holy things, from the fire: every offering of theirs, namely every meal-offering of theirs, and every sin-offering of theirs, and every guilt-offering of theirs which they render to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

notes.official: *miqqōḏeš haqqŏḏāšîm min-hāʾēš* 'of the most holy things, from the fire': the parts of the most holy offerings that are not burned on the altar (the ASV supplies '[reserved]'; the line adds nothing). *kol-qorbānām ləḵol-minḥāṯām ûləḵol-ḥaṭṭāʾṯām ûləḵol-ʾăšāmām* 'every offering of theirs, namely every meal-offering of theirs, and every sin-offering ... and every guilt-offering': the *lə* series specifies what *qorbānām* covers, so *qorbān* is the heading and the three kinds stand under it, not a fourth item (ASV 'even', NJPS 'namely'; GKC §143e). The terms follow the central qorbanot entry: *qorbān* 'offering' (ASV 'oblation', a word the corpus now reserves for *tərûmâ*), *minḥâ* 'meal-offering', *ḥaṭṭāʾṯ* 'sin-offering', *ʾāšām* 'guilt-offering' (ASV 'trespass-offering'). *ʾăšer yāšîḇû lî* 'which they render to me', literally 'return', the language of paying back a debt (Lev 5:23-24 MT).

paragraphs.text: בְּקֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים תֹּאכֲלֶ֑נּוּ כָּל־זָכָר֙ יֹאכַ֣ל אֹת֔וֹ קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִֽהְיֶה־לָּֽךְ׃

i18n.en: As the most holy things you shall eat it; every male shall eat it; it shall be holy to you.

notes.official: *bəqōḏeš haqqŏḏāšîm tōʾḵălennû* 'As the most holy things you shall eat it' (ASV). The phrase can also be locative, 'in a most holy place' (NJPS; Milgrom 1990), i.e. within the sanctuary court (Lev 6:9, 19 MT); the line keeps the ASV and records the alternative.

paragraphs.text: וְזֶה־לְּךָ֞ תְּרוּמַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗ם לְכָל־תְּנוּפֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לְךָ֣ נְתַתִּ֗ים וּלְבָנֶ֧יךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶ֛יךָ אִתְּךָ֖ לְחָק־עוֹלָ֑ם כָּל־טָה֥וֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ יֹאכַ֥ל אֹתֽוֹ׃

i18n.en: And this is yours: the oblation of their gift, all the wave-offerings of the children of Yisra'el; to you I have given them, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever; everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

notes.official: *tərûmaṯ mattānām* 'the oblation of their gift' (draft 'heave-offering'; central qorbanot). *ləḵol-tənûp̄ōṯ* 'all the wave-offerings' (ASV): *tənûp̄â* is a rite of dedication before YHWH, traditionally a waving, by Milgrom's analysis an elevation (`priestly-dues-vocabulary-numbers-18`). These lesser holy portions may be eaten by the priest's daughters and household, if they are clean.

paragraphs.text: כֹּ֚ל חֵ֣לֶב יִצְהָ֔ר וְכָל־חֵ֖לֶב תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְדָגָ֑ן רֵאשִׁיתָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־יִתְּנ֥וּ לַֽיהוָ֖ה לְךָ֥ נְתַתִּֽים׃

i18n.en: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the new wine and of the grain, the first-fruits of them which they give to YHWH, to you I have given them.

notes.official: *kōl ḥēleḇ yiṣhār wəḵol-ḥēleḇ tîrôš wəḏāḡān* 'All the best of the oil, and all the best of the new wine and of the grain'. *ḥēleḇ* 'fat' stands figuratively for the choicest part (Gen 45:18; Deut 32:14). *tîrôš* is new wine (ASV 'vintage'). *rēʾšîṯām* 'the first-fruits of them': the first processed portion, distinct from the *bikkûrîm* 'first-ripe fruits' of v 13 (Milgrom 1990; `priestly-dues-vocabulary-numbers-18`).

paragraphs.text: בִּכּוּרֵ֞י כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּאַרְצָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־יָבִ֥יאוּ לַיהוָ֖ה לְךָ֣ יִהְיֶ֑ה כָּל־טָה֥וֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ יֹאכֲלֶֽנּוּ׃

i18n.en: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to YHWH, shall be yours; everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

notes.official:
*bikkûrê kol-ʾăšer bəʾarṣām ʾăšer-yāḇîʾû laYHWH* 'The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to YHWH': the first produce of the harvest, brought to the sanctuary (Ex 23:19; Deut 26:1-11), distinct from the *rēʾšîṯ* of v 12 (`priestly-dues-vocabulary-numbers-18`). *bəʾarṣām* 'in their land' (central `eretz`). Only those in the priest's household who are clean may eat it.

**Wheel of Heaven reading (reception note, not a translation claim).** *The Book Which Tells the Truth* (ch. 3) quotes this verse ('The firstfruits of all that shall be in their land, which they shall bring unto Yahweh') as evidence that the creators preferred fresh fruit and vegetables to the manna. In the Hebrew the produce is assigned to Aharon and his household ('shall be yours'), and the line renders it so; the reading is recorded here only.

paragraphs.text: כָּל־חֵ֥רֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְךָ֥ יִהְיֶֽה׃

i18n.en: Every devoted thing in Yisra'el shall be yours.

notes.official: *kol-ḥērem bəyiśrāʾēl ləḵā yihyeh* 'Every devoted thing in Yisra'el shall be yours'. *ḥērem* is property irrevocably made over to YHWH, which cannot be redeemed and passes to the priests (Lev 27:21, 28; Ezek 44:29). The same root gives the war-*ḥērem* of 21:2-3 ('devote ... to destruction') and the place name Chormah (new overlay `cherem-devoted-thing-utterly-destroy-numbers`).

paragraphs.text: כָּל־פֶּ֣טֶר רֶ֠חֶם לְֽכָל־בָּשָׂ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִ֧יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֛ה בָּאָדָ֥ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֖ה יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֑ךְ אַ֣ךְ ׀ פָּדֹ֣ה תִפְדֶּ֗ה אֵ֚ת בְּכ֣וֹר הָֽאָדָ֔ם וְאֵ֛ת בְּכֽוֹר־הַבְּהֵמָ֥ה הַטְּמֵאָ֖ה תִּפְדֶּֽה׃

i18n.en: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh, which they bring near to YHWH, both of man and of beast, shall be yours; nevertheless the firstborn of man you shall surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts you shall redeem.

notes.official: *kol-peṭer reḥem* 'Everything that opens the womb' (central `pesach-pidyon-firstborn-passover-firstborn-redemption-cross-corpus`, Ex 13:2, 12-15). *ʾăšer-yaqrîḇû laYHWH* 'which they bring near to YHWH' (ASV 'offer'): *hiqrîḇ* is the technical verb of presentation, from the root of *qorbān*. The human firstborn and the firstlings of unclean animals are redeemed; clean firstlings are sacrificed (v 17).

paragraphs.text: וּפְדוּיָו֙ מִבֶּן־חֹ֣דֶשׁ תִּפְדֶּ֔ה בְּעֶ֨רְכְּךָ֔ כֶּ֛סֶף חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

i18n.en: And those that are to be redeemed of them, from a month old you shall redeem, according to your valuation, for the money of five shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary (it is twenty gerahs).

notes.official: *bəʿerkəḵā* 'according to your valuation' (Lev 27:2-8). *kesep̄ ḥămēšeṯ šəqālîm bəšeqel haqqōḏeš ʿeśrîm gērâ hûʾ* 'for the money of five shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary (it is twenty gerahs)': the redemption price of 3:47; the *gērâ* is the smallest unit of weight, a twentieth of a shekel.

paragraphs.text: אַ֣ךְ בְּֽכוֹר־שׁ֡וֹר אֽוֹ־בְכ֨וֹר כֶּ֜שֶׂב אֽוֹ־בְכ֥וֹר עֵ֛ז לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֑ם אֶת־דָּמָ֞ם תִּזְרֹ֤ק עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ וְאֶת־חֶלְבָּ֣ם תַּקְטִ֔יר אִשֶּׁ֛ה לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: But the firstling of an ox, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, you shall not redeem; they are holy. You shall dash their blood against the altar, and you shall burn their fat as an offering made by fire, for a soothing aroma to YHWH.

notes.official: *ʾeṯ-dāmām tizrōq ʿal-hammizbēaḥ* 'You shall dash their blood against the altar' (ASV 'sprinkle'; central `qorbanot-sacrificial-offering-vocabulary-cluster-cross-corpus`). *wəʾeṯ-ḥelbām taqṭîr* 'and you shall burn their fat': here *ḥēleḇ* is the literal sacrificial fat (Lev 3:3-5). *ʾiššeh* 'an offering made by fire' (ASV): the word is traditionally derived from *ʾēš* 'fire', but it is used of offerings that are not burned and has been compared with Ugaritic *iṯt* 'gift' (Milgrom, *Leviticus 1-16*, AB 3, 1991, 'food gift'); the ASV is kept (`priestly-dues-vocabulary-numbers-18`). *ləriaḥ nîḥōaḥ* 'for a soothing aroma' (central `reach-hannichoach`; ASV 'sweet savor').

paragraphs.text: וּבְשָׂרָ֖ם יִהְיֶה־לָּ֑ךְ כַּחֲזֵ֧ה הַתְּנוּפָ֛ה וּכְשׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִ֖ין לְךָ֥ יִהְיֶֽה׃

i18n.en: And their flesh shall be yours; as the breast of the wave-offering and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.

notes.official: *kaḥăzēh hattənûp̄â ûḵəšôq hayyāmîn* 'as the breast of the wave-offering and as the right thigh', the priests' share of the peace-offerings (Lev 7:30-34; `priestly-dues-vocabulary-numbers-18`).

paragraphs.text: כֹּ֣ל ׀ תְּרוּמֹ֣ת הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֥ימוּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לַֽיהוָה֒ נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְךָ֗ וּלְבָנֶ֧יךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶ֛יךָ אִתְּךָ֖ לְחָק־עוֹלָ֑ם בְּרִית֩ מֶ֨לַח עוֹלָ֥ם הִוא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְךָ֖ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אִתָּֽךְ׃

i18n.en: All the oblations of the holy things which the children of Yisra'el set apart for YHWH I have given to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever; it is a covenant of salt forever before YHWH for you and for your seed with you."

notes.official: *kōl tərûmōṯ haqqŏḏāšîm ʾăšer yārîmû ḇənê-yiśrāʾēl laYHWH* 'All the oblations of the holy things which the children of Yisra'el set apart for YHWH' (draft and ASV 'heave-offerings ... offer'): noun and verb are from the same root *rwm*, both under the central qorbanot ruling. *bərîṯ melaḥ ʿôlām* 'a covenant of salt forever': salt, which preserves, marks an unbreakable agreement (Lev 2:13; 2 Chr 13:5), and in the ANE salt was eaten at the conclusion of treaties (Levine, *Numbers 1-20*, AB 4A, 1993; `priestly-dues-vocabulary-numbers-18`).

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֗ן בְּאַרְצָם֙ לֹ֣א תִנְחָ֔ל וְחֵ֕לֶק לֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ בְּתוֹכָ֑ם אֲנִ֤י חֶלְקְךָ֙ וְנַחֲלָ֣תְךָ֔ בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ (ס)

i18n.en: And YHWH said to Aharon, "You shall have no inheritance in their land, nor shall you have any portion among them; I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Yisra'el.

notes.official: *bəʾarṣām lōʾ ṯinḥāl* 'You shall have no inheritance in their land' (central `eretz`). *ʾănî ḥelqəḵā wənaḥălāṯəḵā* 'I am your portion and your inheritance': the priests receive no tribal territory; their 'portion' is YHWH's dues (Deut 10:9; 18:1-2; Josh 13:14, 33; Ezek 44:28).

paragraphs.text: וְלִבְנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י הִנֵּ֥ה נָתַ֛תִּי כָּל־מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְנַחֲלָ֑ה חֵ֤לֶף עֲבֹֽדָתָם֙ אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֣ם עֹֽבְדִ֔ים אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

i18n.en: And to the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Yisra'el for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, the service of the tent of meeting.

notes.official: *kol-maʿăśēr bəyiśrāʾēl* 'all the tithe in Yisra'el' (central `maaser-first-pre-sinai`, Gen 14:20; 28:22) is assigned to the Levites as their *naḥălâ* 'in return for their service' (*ḥēlep̄ ʿăḇōḏāṯām*).

paragraphs.text: וְלֹא־יִקְרְב֥וּ ע֛וֹד בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לָשֵׂ֥את חֵ֖טְא לָמֽוּת׃

i18n.en: And the children of Yisra'el shall no more come near the tent of meeting, lest they bear sin and die.

notes.official: *lāśēʾṯ ḥēṭʾ lāmûṯ* 'lest they bear sin and die', literally 'to bear sin, to die'.

paragraphs.text: וְעָבַ֨ד הַלֵּוִ֜י ה֗וּא אֶת־עֲבֹדַת֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְהֵ֖ם יִשְׂא֣וּ עֲוֺנָ֑ם חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּבְתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יִנְחֲל֖וּ נַחֲלָֽה׃

i18n.en: But the Levite, he shall do the service of the tent of meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity; it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations; and among the children of Yisra'el they shall have no inheritance.

notes.official: *wəhēm yiśʾû ʿăwōnām* 'and they shall bear their iniquity': the Levites carry the responsibility for encroachment by the Israelites (Milgrom 1970). *ḥuqqaṯ ʿôlām* 'a statute forever'.

paragraphs.text: כִּ֞י אֶת־מַעְשַׂ֣ר בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֤ימוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ תְּרוּמָ֔ה נָתַ֥תִּי לַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה עַל־כֵּן֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי לָהֶ֔ם בְּתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יִנְחֲל֖וּ נַחֲלָֽה׃ (פ)

i18n.en: For the tithe of the children of Yisra'el, which they set apart for YHWH as an oblation, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance; therefore I have said to them, 'Among the children of Yisra'el they shall have no inheritance.'"

notes.official: *ʾăšer yārîmû laYHWH tərûmâ* 'which they set apart for YHWH as an oblation' (draft and ASV 'offer as a heave-offering'): the whole tithe is a *tərûmâ* to YHWH, which he assigns to the Levites (central qorbanot; `maaser-first-pre-sinai`). YHWH's earlier words are quoted in single marks.

paragraphs.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

i18n.en: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

notes.official: The second speech, now to Moses, concerns the Levites' own tithe (vv 26-32).

paragraphs.text: וְאֶל־הַלְוִיִּ֣ם תְּדַבֵּר֮ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶם֒ כִּֽי־תִ֠קְחוּ מֵאֵ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תִּי לָכֶ֛ם מֵאִתָּ֖ם בְּנַחֲלַתְכֶ֑ם וַהֲרֵמֹתֶ֤ם מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ר מִן־הַֽמַּעֲשֵֽׂר׃

i18n.en: "And to the Levites you shall speak and say to them, 'When you take from the children of Yisra'el the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall set apart from it an oblation for YHWH, a tithe of the tithe.

notes.official: *wahărēmōṯem mimmennû tərûmaṯ YHWH maʿăśēr min-hammaʿăśēr* 'then you shall set apart from it an oblation for YHWH, a tithe of the tithe' (draft and ASV 'offer up ... a heave-offering'; central qorbanot). The Levites, who receive the tithe, give a tenth of it to the priests (v 28; Neh 10:39 MT). Moses' message to the Levites is set in single marks within YHWH's speech.

paragraphs.text: וְנֶחְשַׁ֥ב לָכֶ֖ם תְּרוּמַתְכֶ֑ם כַּדָּגָן֙ מִן־הַגֹּ֔רֶן וְכַֽמְלֵאָ֖ה מִן־הַיָּֽקֶב׃

i18n.en: And your oblation shall be reckoned to you as though it were the grain of the threshing-floor and as the fullness of the winepress.

notes.official: *wəneḥšaḇ lāḵem tərûmaṯḵem kaddāḡān min-haggōren wəḵamməlēʾâ min-hayyāqeḇ* 'And your oblation (central qorbanot) shall be reckoned to you as though it were the grain of the threshing-floor and as the fullness of the winepress': the Levites' tithe counts as if it were the produce of their own land (Milgrom 1990). *məlēʾâ* 'fullness' is the yield of the press (Ex 22:28 MT).

paragraphs.text: כֵּ֣ן תָּרִ֤ימוּ גַם־אַתֶּם֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִכֹּל֙ מַעְשְׂרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּקְח֔וּ מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּנְתַתֶּ֤ם מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ אֶת־תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

i18n.en: Thus you also shall set apart an oblation for YHWH from all your tithes which you receive from the children of Yisra'el; and from it you shall give YHWH's oblation to Aharon the priest.

notes.official: *kēn tārîmû ḡam-ʾattem tərûmaṯ YHWH* 'Thus you also shall set apart an oblation for YHWH' (draft 'offer a heave-offering'; central qorbanot). *ləʾahărōn hakkōhēn* 'to Aharon the priest', i.e. to the priesthood (`maaser-first-pre-sinai`).

paragraphs.text: מִכֹּל֙ מַתְּנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תָּרִ֕ימוּ אֵ֖ת כָּל־תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה מִכָּל־חֶלְבּ֔וֹ אֶֽת־מִקְדְּשׁ֖וֹ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

i18n.en: Out of all your gifts you shall set apart every oblation of YHWH, of all the best of it, the hallowed part of it, out of it.'

notes.official: *tārîmû ʾēṯ kol-tərûmaṯ YHWH mikkol-ḥelbô ʾeṯ-miqdəšô mimmennû* 'you shall set apart every oblation of YHWH, of all the best of it, the hallowed part of it, out of it' (draft 'offer every heave-offering'; central qorbanot): the Levitical tithe must come from the choicest part (*ḥēleḇ*, as v 12).

paragraphs.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם בַּהֲרִֽימְכֶ֤ם אֶת־חֶלְבּוֹ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְנֶחְשַׁב֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם כִּתְבוּאַ֥ת גֹּ֖רֶן וְכִתְבוּאַ֥ת יָֽקֶב׃

i18n.en: And you shall say to them, 'When you have set apart the best of it from it, then it shall be reckoned to the Levites as the produce of the threshing-floor and as the produce of the winepress.

notes.official: *bahărîməḵem ʾeṯ-ḥelbô mimmennû* 'When you have set apart the best of it from it' (draft and ASV 'heaved'): the infinitive of *hērîm* (central qorbanot). The remainder then counts for the Levites as ordinary produce, *kiṯḇûʾaṯ gōren* 'as the produce of the threshing-floor'.

paragraphs.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ בְּכָל־מָק֔וֹם אַתֶּ֖ם וּבֵֽיתְכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־שָׂכָ֥ר הוּא֙ לָכֶ֔ם חֵ֥לֶף עֲבֹֽדַתְכֶ֖ם בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

i18n.en: And you shall eat it in every place, you and your households; for it is your reward in return for your service in the tent of meeting.

notes.official: *kî-śāḵār hûʾ lāḵem* 'for it is your reward': *śāḵār* is payment for work (NRSV 'payment'); the ASV 'reward' is kept (`priestly-dues-vocabulary-numbers-18`). *bəḵol-māqôm* 'in every place': unlike the most holy portions (v 10), the tithe may be eaten anywhere.

paragraphs.text: וְלֹֽא־תִשְׂא֤וּ עָלָיו֙ חֵ֔טְא בַּהֲרִֽימְכֶ֥ם אֶת־חֶלְבּ֖וֹ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְאֶת־קָדְשֵׁ֧י בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לֹ֥א תְחַלְּל֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תָמֽוּתוּ׃ (פ)

i18n.en: And you shall bear no sin because of it, when you have set apart the best of it from it; and you shall not profane the holy things of the children of Yisra'el, that you not die.'"

notes.official: *wəlōʾ-ṯiśʾû ʿālāyw ḥēṭʾ bahărîməḵem ʾeṯ-ḥelbô mimmennû* 'And you shall bear no sin because of it, when you have set apart the best of it from it' (draft 'heaved'; central qorbanot). *wəʾeṯ-qāḏšê ḇənê-yiśrāʾēl lōʾ ṯəḥalləlû* 'and you shall not profane the holy things of the children of Yisra'el': eating the tithe before the priests' tenth has been removed would profane it.
